_note: Answers used by the career-ops Autofill Chrome extension. Replace each null with your answer in quotes, e.g. "first_name": "Jane". null (no quotes) = never auto-filled: you answer it yourself. Lines starting with _help are notes for you; the extension ignores them. Edits apply on the next page, no reload needed. This file is private: don't share it.
_help_first_name: Your legal first name, e.g. "Jane". Also used to name uploaded files First_Last_Resume.pdf.
_help_full_name: First and last name together, e.g. "Jane Smith".
_help_preferred_name: The name you go by, if different (else repeat your first name).
_help_middle_name: Your middle name. Use "" (empty quotes) if you have none, so it stops asking you about it; null = answer yourself.
_help_email: The email address employers should use.
_help_address_line2: Apartment / unit, e.g. "Apt 4". Use "" if none.
_help_website: Portfolio or personal site URL, or null if you have none.
_help_school: Your most recent school (where the M.S. is from), exactly as it should appear.
_help_degree: Degree level of your most recent degree. CHECK: "Master of Science" fits an M.S.; change it if your degree is different (e.g. "Master of Engineering").
_help_discipline: Field of study / major. CHECK this matches your program's official name.
_help_gpa: GPA of your most recent degree, e.g. "3.7" (goes only on that degree). null = never filled.
_help_current_title: Current or most recent job title, e.g. "Project Engineer Intern". null if you'd rather not.
_help_years_experience: Years of full-time experience, e.g. "1". null = answer yourself.
_help_authorized_to_work_us: CHECK: "Are you legally authorized to work in the US?" On F-1 OPT (or STEM OPT) the honest answer is Yes.
_help_require_sponsorship: CHECK: "Will you now or in the future require sponsorship (e.g. H-1B)?" On OPT and needing H-1B later the honest answer is Yes. The text in brackets is typed only into free-text boxes. A question asking whether you can work WITHOUT sponsorship is never guessed.
require_sponsorship: Yes (F-1 OPT now; will need H-1B sponsorship in the future)
_help_willing_to_relocate: "Are you willing to relocate?" "Yes" or "No". null = answer each time.
_help_has_drivers_license: "Do you have a valid driver's license?" true / false (no quotes), or null. Field and superintendent roles often ask.
_help_salary_expectation: Used only when the posting shows no pay range (otherwise the top of the posted range is used). e.g. "75000". null = answer yourself.
_help_start_date: When you can start, e.g. "June 2027" or "Immediately".
_help_how_did_you_hear: Default answer for "How did you hear about us?".
_help_licenses: Licenses / certifications you hold, e.g. "OSHA 30". Only list what you actually have. null = answer yourself.
_help_previously_employed_here: CHECK: "Have you worked for this company before?" One answer for every company: if you apply back to a past employer, answer that one yourself.
_help_relatives_at_company: CHECK: "Do you have relatives working here?"
_help_has_noncompete: CHECK: "Are you bound by a non-compete or non-solicitation agreement?"
_help_essential_functions: CHECK: "Can you perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation?"
_help_gov_employed_now: "Are you currently employed by a government / public agency?" "Yes" / "No" / null.
_help_gov_employed_recent: "Have you worked for a government / public agency in the last 2 years?" (an internship with a city or state counts).
_help_family_gov_employed: "Does a family member work for a government / public agency?"
_help_sms_consent: "May we text you about your application?" "Yes" / "No" / null.
_help_eeo: Voluntary self-identification (EEO). Optional: null = choose yourself each time.
_help_eeo_gender: e.g. "Female", "Male", or "I don't wish to answer".
_help_eeo_race: e.g. "Asian", "White", "Black or African American", or "I don't wish to answer".
